TA01 Acog.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

Vcog 6x Scope.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

Klassik LM.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

PM II Ultrashort.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

Vcog 8x Scope.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

Tango MSR 1-8x.info: A standard LPVO scope designed for the M7 NGSW program!

Steyr Integrated Scope.info: Integrated railed version of the UAR scope.

PU-1 Scope.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

Hensoldt 3x Sight.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

Malcolm 3x Scope.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

Leupold M8-6x.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

FF 3x NV.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

PSO-1M2 Scope.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

Electra 5x.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

Sagittarius 40x.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

KOM 10x42.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

CS/OS15.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

SUSAT Scope.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

M145.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

C79.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

TA11 Acog.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

Leupold Mark 4.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

FN 4x Scope.info:
A simple in-house manufactured optic made especially for the FAL rifles along the custom dust cover to mount the scope, provides a clear sight image being simple to read although isn't meant for really long ranges.

Model by Rialag

VHS-D2 CT 1.5x.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The VHS-D2 CT 1.5x is an integrated telescopic scope for the VHS-D2.

EOTech Vudu 1-10.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

PSO-12.7.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

Acog Scope.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

Reflector Scope.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

PSO-1 Scope.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

Hensoldt Dual Optic.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

Malcolm 6x Scope.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Long version of the Malcolm scope design.

TA33 Acog.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

PM II.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

Swarovski Scope.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

Hensoldt Z24.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

PK-A.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

TA44 Acog.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

ZF69 Scope.info: A Nomensland fixed-power precision riflescope used as the primary optic for the UAR HBAR-T configuration.

Colt Retro Scope.info: A reissued version of the original M16A1 4x21mm rifle scope, mounting directly to the gun's carry handle. Minimal impact on handling.

NXS 5.5-22.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

HD-N 4-16x44.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

Leupold M8-2x.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

Global Offensive Scope.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

Unertl 8x Scope.info: The standard issue scope for the Springfield M1903. This absurdly long target scope was designed by John Unertl and was found to be the best for the requirements of the military at the time.

SIDEWINDER ED.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

Olympian Target Sight.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

PRO 3-9x Scope.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.
